direction: Technical editorial atlas: navy ground, ivory text, gold control messages, teal resource ownership and application paths, coral loss. Relationship meanings are stated within their respective views.
thesis: A desired replica count survives changes in Pods while a Service provides stable access to eligible endpoints.
model: Containers inside Pods inside worker nodes
Service and EndpointSlice configuration of a kube-proxy data plane
visible_evidence: API-centred control plane with two watcher branches
Three Pods distributed across two nodes
A separate application-traffic path bypassing the API server
reading_order: Control and execution above; Service forwarding and recovery below. Reuse Pod names and addresses across views.
production_contract: Free editable scene, generated by scripts/gallery/kubernetes.js. One continuous overview route would hide the necessary ownership, traffic and reconciliation relationships.
scope: Illustrative workload, Pod IPs, Service IP and placement. A kube-proxy-based data plane is shown. Storage, ingress, high availability, detailed CNI setup and failure-detection timing are outside this figure.
